introduction:
A Ration Card in Maharashtra is a vital official document that serves as a key identity and address proof, and is required for various government welfare schemes. It entitles eligible families to subsidized food grains under the public distribution system.

Applications can be processed online through the official portal rcms.mahafood.gov.in or offline at local administrative offices.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Target State: Maharashtra
  • Official Portal: rcms.mahafood.gov.in
  • Application Fee: ₹100 (for online processing)
  • Primary Benefits: Subsidized food grains, serves as a vital identity/address proof, and is required for various government welfare schemes.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

File Specifications: Document uploads must be in PDF format and each file must be less than 200 KB.
Identity & DOB Proof
  • Identity Proof (Any one): Aadhaar Card (mandatory), Voter ID, PAN Card, Passport, or Driving License
  • Date of Birth Proof (Any one): Birth certificate or High school marksheet
  • HOF Photo: Passport size photo of Head of Family (JPEG/PNG format, under 20 KB)
Address & Gas Proof
  • Address Proof (Any one): Recent Electricity bill, Telephone bill, Rent agreement, or Gas connection receipt
Financial & Special Info
  • Financial Details: Bank Passbook (IFSC and Account Number)
  • Income Certificate: Official Income Certificate from the Tahsil/Aaple Sarkar portal
  • Special Categories (if applicable): E-shram card or Migrant Labor certificates
Card Types Based on Income
  • AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana): For the poorest families (income generally below ₹15,000/year).
  • PHH (Priority Household): Rural income <₹44,000/year; Urban <₹59,000/year.
  • APL (Above Poverty Line - Orange Card): For middle-income groups.
  • White Card: For families with higher annual incomes (typically >₹1 Lakh).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via RCMS Portal

Follow these steps to apply for a ration card online on the RCMS portal:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Registration
    Visit the official portal rcms.mahafood.gov.in and navigate to Sign in/Register → Public Login. Select New User Sign Up, enter your Aadhaar, Mobile, and Email details, and create a Login ID and Password.
  2. Login
    Sign in using either Aadhaar OTP or your newly created credentials.
  3. Member Entry
    Select your District, Taluka, and Village, then add all family members. Note: The first member added must be the Head of Family (HOF).
  4. HOF Details
    Upload the Head of Family's photo (JPEG/PNG, under 20 KB) and fill in personal details, including occupation and exact annual income.
  5. Address & Gas Info
    Enter your residential address and details of your gas connection (Consumer No. and Agency name).
  6. Document Upload
    Attach the required PDF proofs for Identity, Address, and Income (each file must be less than 200 KB).
  7. FPS Mapping
    Select your preferred local "Fair Price Shop" (Ration Shop) from the provided list based on your village.
  8. Payment
    Proceed to pay the ₹100 application fee via the UPI/QR code gateway provided on the site.
  9. Submission
    Confirm all details, submit the form, and download the acknowledgment receipt.
Offline Verification: Although the process is online, you may be required to visit the local Tahsil Office (Supply Department) if the Food Supply Inspector requests original document verification.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline at local administrative office

If you cannot access the online portal, follow these steps:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Obtain Form
    Visit the nearest Tahsil Office or Zonal Rationing Office and collect 'Form No. 1' for a new ration card.
  2. Fill & Attach
    Complete the form with details of all family members. Attach attested photocopies of Aadhaar cards, the original Income Certificate, and residence proof (Electricity bill/Voter ID).
  3. Affidavit
    In some cases, a self-declaration or an affidavit on a small stamp paper (declaring no existing ration card) may be required.
  4. Submission
    Submit the physical file to the Clerk at the Rationing Window and pay the nominal administrative fee (usually ₹5 to ₹50 depending on the card type).
  5. Verification
    A Food Supply Inspector (FSI) will conduct a field visit to your home to verify the family's residence and income status.
afterApplying:
After Applying — What Next?

Tracking Status

You can track the status on the RCMS portal using the "Track your Grievance" or "Application Status" link with your application number.

Verification Process

The Food Supply Inspector (FSI) reviews the digital or physical file. If any discrepancies are found, the application may be "Rejected" or "Sent back for Correction."

Approval & Delivery

Once approved, the status will update to "Approved," and the ration card will be generated. You can download a digital version or collect the physical booklet from the Tahsil office.
